## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Describe the specific use case or scenario where this feature would be beneficial.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, please share them.

### AI/ML Considerations
- [ ] Requires new ML model training
- [ ] Needs additional embeddings/vector operations
- [ ] Impacts mobile testing framework integration
- [ ] Requires new API endpoints

### Technical Considerations
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Requires database migrations
- [ ] Needs documentation updates
- [ ] Impacts existing tests

## Examples
Provide examples of how this feature would be used:

```python
# Example code showing how the feature would work
```

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Priority
- [ ] Low - Nice to have
- [ ] Medium - Would improve user experience
- [ ] High - Critical for important use case
- [ ] Urgent - Blocking current functionality

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched for existing feature requests
- [ ] I have provided a clear use case
- [ ] I understand this may not be implemented immediately
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to the implementation
